text:
Kai: quick sync on stream controls — users want something less modal than a big stop button. thinking compact inline controls in the bubble.
Maya P: agree. prefer verbs: Interrupt vs Retry vs Discard. Also we should avoid the word Stop in product copy.
Samir: runtime supports early-stop. resume is tricky; we can fake resume by issuing a regen with the partial text as context.
Rosa (design): visual idea: three tiny icon-only buttons that expand on hover to labels. default collapsed state shows a subtle separator so it doesn't look like a toolbar. on mobile, move into overflow.
Kai: Accessibility: make sure the expanded label is keyboard-focusable and that the collapsed icons have aria-labels.
a11y-bot: checklist: 1) icons have aria-label, 2) actions announce via aria-live polite, 3) reduced-motion respects prefers-reduced-motion, 4) contrast >= 4.5:1 for icon color.
Maya P: microcopy proposals: Interrupt -> "Interrupt generation", Retry -> "Retry from here", Discard -> "Discard draft". Short tooltips only. Run a microcopy panel with 6 engineers.
Samir: dev note: add stream meta fields: stream_state (active|interrupted|discarded|finished), partial_text token_count, remaining_tokens_estimate (optional). we can compute remaining estimate on the client using model heuristics.
Kai: token counter UX: while streaming show "used / est" compact (e.g., "32 / ~150"). on hover show tokens/sec sparkline. keep it low-contrast so it doesn't draw focus.
Rosa (design): animations: a tiny pulse on first chunk, then no more. if reduced-motion is on, disable pulse. chunk boundary hint should be a 2px fade-in at left edge of bubble. call it "chunk hint" in spec.
Maya P: add a11y copy for sparkline alt: "Token rate: X tokens per second". and keyboard shortcuts: default Esc to Interrupt in playground, configurable in preferences. document shortcuts in help.
Samir: feature flag: playground_stream_inline_controls. will gate new payload fields behind it. also add client-side config to map Esc -> interrupt or custom hotkey.
Kai: let's do a short usability run: 8 devs, focus on clarity of Interrupt vs Retry, and whether the token estimate helps decisions. Priya to own test.
Rosa (design): pushing updated frames to Figma: https://redwood.design/figma/playground/inline-controls (frames 4-7).
Maya P: I'll run microcopy test today and report.
deploy-bot: sandbox deploy 2026-04-15T11:02:05 includes featureflag: playground_stream_inline_controls.
